subject: New note: Found non-API call to R: 'ENCLOS'

messages.author: e7a8779ef7a944e5
messages.subject: New note: Found non-API call to R: 'ENCLOS'
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to submit a new package (tinyVAST) to CRAN, and getting what I think is a new CRAN check with note below (see attached for full copy of checks) that seems to be triggered by my integration of TMB.  I don't see anything about this note in the TMB materials online, and actually don't see the subsection "Moving into C API compliance" in the R manual (although I see some chatter in R devel comments e.g. here).

Has anyone seen this, or have a suggested fix?

Thanks
Jim  

* checking compiled code ... NOTE
File 'tinyVAST/libs/x64/tinyVAST.dll':
  Found non-API call to R: 'ENCLOS'

Compiled code should not call non-API entry points in R.

See 'Writing portable packages' in the 'Writing R Extensions' manual,
and section 'Moving into C API compliance' for issues with the use of
non-API entry points.

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: New note: Found non-API call to R: 'ENCLOS'
parts:
Seems to be caused by this recent change in R-devel:
https://github.com/wch/r-source/commit/c433dec5c546b715c1c33f466df9ed5c95e667cb

TMB uses 'ENCLOS' implicitly via the REPORT macro, so many TMB dependent CRAN packages should start seeing this note. I'll have to find an alternative...
